[19/10/2026, 10:02] Amina: Habari, simu ya Tecno Spark 20 bado inapatikana?
[19/10/2026, 10:05] Baraka: Nzuri. Ndiyo, bado ipo. Ni 128GB, rangi nyeusi
[19/10/2026, 10:06] Amina: Bei yake ni ngapi?
[19/10/2026, 10:07] Baraka: Shilingi elfu kumi na tatu (13,000)
[19/10/2026, 10:09] Amina: Ni ghali kidogo. Naweza kulipa elfu kumi na moja?
[19/10/2026, 10:12] Baraka: Siwezi kushuka hadi hapo. Nitakuuzia kwa elfu kumi na moja na mia tano (11,500), bei ya mwisho
[19/10/2026, 10:13] Amina: Sawa, nimekubali 11,500. Skrini ina ufa wowote?
[19/10/2026, 10:15] Baraka: Haina ufa wowote, na inakuja na chaja yake halisi
[19/10/2026, 10:16] Amina: Mimi niko Kisumu. Unaweza kutuma kupitia G4S?
[19/10/2026, 10:18] Baraka: Ndiyo, nitaipeleka G4S Jumatano
[19/10/2026, 10:19] Amina: Asante sana, tumekubaliana
notes: Relative date: Swahili negotiation 13,000 -> 11,500 with prices partly in words; 'Jumatano' (Wednesday) said on Mon 19 Oct = ship_by 2026-10-21.
